How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?

Once your order ships, you'll receive a shipping confirmation email with a tracking link. Tracking numbers can take 24–48 hours to become active on the carrier's site after the label is created.

If you haven't received a shipping confirmation email yet, your order may not have shipped. To look up your order status, I'll need your email address and either your order ID (starts with USA- or CA-) or your ZIP/postal code.

If tracking shows no movement 48 hours after the label is created, or no new scans appear 48 hours after the last scan, the shipment may need further review.

In the meantime, carriers can sometimes miss scans between facilities, which makes tracking appear stuck — it typically updates within 24–48 hours once the next scan posts. If your package arrives in full and in good condition, no action is needed even if tracking never updated.
